= AhaWiki =
* [https://ahawiki.net]

A wiki engine, written in Scala on Play. Several wikis run on one instance, told apart by the host they are asked for.

== Documents ==
* '''AGENTS.md''' — how to work in this repository, and an index of everything below.
* '''docs/RunningLocally.md''' — what to arrange before <code>sbt run</code> gives you a working server.
* '''docs/Testing.md''' — how the tests get a database schema.
* '''docs/Database.md''' — what the columns mean.
